food-chain.def: A single sequence of organisms, each eaten by the next, showing one path that energy and matter take from producers to top consumers.

food-web.def: All the interconnected food chains in an ecosystem, showing that most organisms eat and are eaten by several species.

detritivore.def: An organism, such as an earthworm, millipede or crab, that eats detritus (dead organic matter) and breaks it into smaller pieces, speeding decomposition.
